name: United Malacca Berhad
summary: United Malacca Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the palm oil cultivation, palm oil milling, and agroforestry plantation businesses in Malaysia and Indonesia. The company operates through two segments: Plantation and Investment Holding. It provides management consultancy services; and fresh fruit bunches, and palm kernels. The company was formerly known as The United Malacca Rubber Estates, Berhad. United Malacca Berhad was incorporated in 1910 and is headquartered in Taman Melaka Raya, Malaysia.
